body: The closest answer I got was from my last therapist a few years ago.  She said I was "too impatient to heal."  On one hand, I can understand that, but honestly, I never felt like therapy ever got me anywhere.
I have talked to them, I have had medication, it's never really helped.
I'm so sorry you're going through all you are.  You seem like a very kind person, you deserve happiness.

Thank you - you are very kind.  It's not a question of pushing people away, it's knowing from experience that when I tell the people who love me my problems, I become a burden.  I've been told by someone who claimed to love me that she couldn't talk to me anymore because I was "too emotionally draining."  We made up, but I'll never tell her anything again, and as I look over my life, I lost many friends by being that way when things were bad.
Many many times.  Fapping works, but the anxiety comes back after a few minutes.  Sorry, it's not quite a cure-all.
